newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end at record for third-straight session.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end at record for third-straight session.

text.p: Leading UK shares finished at a record high for the third straight session on Wednesday, as the market continued to celebrate the British government's decision to take interest rate policy out of the political arena.
A weak start on Wall Street dragged UK shares from the day's best levels but the FTSE 100 still managed to end 18.2 points firmer to a record closing level of 4,537.5.

"It is hard to over-estimate the impact of the move to give the Bank of England independence," one senior dealer said. "It has given investors confidence in our monetary policy. People think inflation can now actually be kept under control."
